data.name: Niti
data.gender_notes: Niti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Niti is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'nit' which means 'rule' or 'direction'. In Hindu mythology, Niti is considered the goddess of righteousness and morality. She is also known as the 'Goddess of Good Conduct'. The name Niti carries the meaning “Rule, Direction” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niti usually hope their child will grow to embody rule, direction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of righteousness and moral guidance
data.etymology: Niti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rule, Direction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niti total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
